rounds.restatement: Add a core analyze(template) function that walks the parsed AST (and the evaluator's own expression splitting) to report every input variable a template reads: its root name, the distinct full paths, the constructs that read it (output, if, elseif, case, for source, list_item, table cells, condition operands on both sides of AND/OR/comparisons/contains), and whether every read has a ?? default (optional). It also lists the filters applied with counts and flags unknown filters as diagnostics. FOR item names inside their loop, @-metadata and operator words are not inputs. The n8n node's strict-mode pre-check switches to analyze, so it no longer rejects loop item names or ??-defaulted variables, and the regex-based extractAllVariables is removed from core. No existing test body may change and no runtime dependency may be added.
